title: fix(plugin-security,organizations): seed-ownership claims re-own by row when a stored expression reads owner_id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5kePHewF7u1mfD8BHmUxYd)_
Fixes #25668

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Both seed-ownership claims re-owned seeded rows with one `multi: true` predicate update. A stored computed field (a non-formula field with an `expression`) that reads `owner_id`, directly or one hop through the lookup, computes a different value on each row once the owner is set. The engine refuses such a predicate update ("update those rows by id"), so every seeded row of that object stayed ownerless. Triage `6385814124` keeps that refusal and routes the fix to the two claim sites. This PR does that.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/claim-seed-ownership.ts`: a new `storedExpressionReadsOwner(schema)` decides, per object, whether a stored expression reads `owner_id`. It counts a direct read, a hop through `owner_id`, and a read through another stored field that does. An expression whose reads cannot be named counts as a reader. Reads come from `analyzeRelationshipTraversals` (`@objectstack/formula`), the member reader the engine's stored-expression planning uses. Such an object goes to `claimPredicateByRow`:
  - The NULL arm writes each seeded id it already names, with no read.
  - The `usr_system` arm reads ids a page at a time (`CLAIM_PAGE_ROWS`, the bound the paged fallback already reads by) and writes them. It stops when a read is empty, or when a page re-owns nothing.
  - Each write is a compare-and-set: the arm's owner term plus the row's `id`, `multi: true`. The engine evaluates that as a predicate over one row and computes the stored value from that row. A row someone owned in the meantime is not taken.
  - Every other object keeps the predicate write and its paged fallback, unchanged.
- `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership.ts`: the same check (a twin, as the two files already twin their helpers) and `claimChunkByRow`. It writes one compare-and-set per seeded id of each chunk: `{ organization_id, owner_id: null, id }`.
- A row whose own write is refused stays unowned. It is reported once per batch with the claim's existing warning (`claimSeedOwnership failed for …` / `claimOrgSeedOwnership failed for …`), with the refused count, up to 20 ids and the first refusal's message. The object's other rows are still claimed.
- `@objectstack/organizations` gains the `@objectstack/formula` dependency (`package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`). Its `vitest.config.ts` gains the matching source alias, which `pnpm check:test-source-alias` asked for.

File surface: the claim's two files, their tests, one changeset, plus the three organizations manifest/config lines above. Nothing under `packages/objectql/**`.

## Evidence

Head `1e608716`. Every number below was read on this branch.

- New pins, real engine:
  - `plugin-security/src/claim-seed-ownership-stored-expression.pin.test.ts`, on `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3).
  - `organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership-stored-expression.pin.test.ts`, on `SqliteWasmDriver`.
  - Each pins: the direct and the one-hop shape (the hop is HotCRM's `display_title` expression), each with four seeded rows that compute different values. The plugin-security pin adds two seed-identity rows. After the claim every such row is owned and its stored `display_title` is its own expression over its own row. The guest row the seed never reported, another organization's row and a human-owned row are untouched. A control object whose stored expression reads no owner keeps the bulk path: plugin-security makes 2 predicate writes and organizations 1. A row refused by a code-registered hook stays unowned and reported while the rest are claimed.
  - Result: `Tests 4 passed (4)` in each file.
- Ablation (restore the bulk write via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run, restore; the tool verified the blob back to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - plugin-security: `const claim = claimPredicate;` gives `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`. The failures carry the engine's own refusal: `'display_title' on 'probe_forecast_direct' is computed from its expression on every write, and this update changes its inputs on rows where it then computes different values, … update those rows by id`. That is the card's measured symptom.
  - organizations: `const claim = claimChunk;` gives `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`, with the same refusal. This measures the organizations claim, which the card had only read.
- Package suites: `@objectstack/plugin-security` `Test Files 223 passed`, `Tests 4632 passed | 45 skipped`. `@objectstack/organizations` `Test Files 17 passed`, `Tests 243 passed` (re-run at `1e608716`). `typecheck` exit 0 on both. `eslint --no-inline-config` over both packages exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 84 families on this diff, and all 84 exit 0 at `1e608716`. Reconciled: `dispatch-gates --ran` reads "84 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 84 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 84 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". The first round, at `5aa93aa9`, found one real red, `check:test-source-alias` (the new `@objectstack/formula` import had no source alias in organizations), fixed in `1e608716`. It also had three prerequisite exits (3): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` (some packages had no `dist/`) and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; its pinned fixture commit fetched). All three exit 0 on the final run. Repo-wide families (`pnpm lint` and the CI roster) are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Row-by-row cost.** It is a full engine write per row, paid only on objects whose stored expressions read `owner_id`. The NULL arm is bounded by the seed's own report (chunks of `CLAIM_PAGE_ROWS`). The seed-identity arm is bounded by pages of `CLAIM_PAGE_ROWS` and `MAX_CLAIM_PAGES`. Not measured at seed sizes beyond the pins.
- **Spellings.** The routing reads `owner_id` with the platform's one member reader. A stored expression that reaches `owner_id` through a spelling that reader does not name would still get the predicate write and the existing warning. No such spelling is known. Noted, not filed.
- **Twin helpers.** `storedExpressionReadsOwner` / `expressionReads` exist in both claim files, as `affectedRowCount` and `hasField` already do. The two packages share no runtime dependency that could host them. Noted, carrier: none.
- **Not measured here.** The card's second "Done when" line, HotCRM's patched `display_title` booting with 0 ownerless forecasts, needs a release that carries this. It is the `repo:hotcrm` seat's reading on hotcrm#2242.
- The card's "Context, not asked here" item (a stored title reading a lookup goes stale when the lookup target is renamed) is untouched.
